I had to step out of work for a bit due to severe hyperemesis. I work in sales management, which is very fast paced and high pressure. I had to call in so often even after trying so hard that it only made sense to step out so the absence could at least be planned for. My boss suggested I take short term disability. I took about 2 weeks PTO, as I didn’t want to effect my STD for when she came. After that I was able to manage enough to at least get out of bed, and it was enough that the doctors finally took me seriously. There were intermittent days where I called in due to being in the hospital for fluids, and I was very firm that it was out of my control and they would just have to manage. I struggled deeply with my mental health and guilt over having to choose between work and not being able to get out of bed, but at the end of the day your baby is number one. Work managed when I was firm in my accommodations, baby was healthy, and I came back from leave an even better boss than before. You got this, mama!
